identity.name: classify_coa_scope
identity.description: Single-phase ENRICHER over its own input table: streams every pending CoA (never classified, or touched by the coa root after its last classification) through the shipped description-keyword classifier (scripts/lib/coa-scope-classifier.js, Spec 42 §6.6.D; Spec 84 §7 dual path) and writes coa_type_class, project_type, scope_tags, structure_type, scope_classified_at (the run clock) and scope_source ('description') back onto coa_applications, one explicit-VALUES UPDATE per batch, each its own short transaction (the compute_parcel_cost_estimates post_commit form).

why_lock.text: Spec 42 §6.8 Phase D allocation, ported from the legacy `const ADVISORY_LOCK_ID = 4202` (classify-coa-scope.js:37); recorded in src/tests/pipeline-advisory-lock.infra.test.ts.

guard_why.text: Spec 124 §2 Rule 9 / V7 (grandfathered.json), the Q-CE2 / Q-W4G-1 form (operator y 2026-10-18 / 2026-10-19; 124a §B14): every streamed CoA advances its classification and the scope_classified_at watermark unconditionally, exactly as the legacy unguarded UPDATE did (classify-coa-scope.js:133-144, pinned L5/L8), or the pending cursor re-fetches an unchanged or all-NULL row on every run forever (the defect b3373342 fixed). The narrowing is the cursor (the pending set buildSourceSql streams), never a value guard: a guard naming the run clock could never filter.

guard_columns_why.text: LG-9 escape hatch, moot here (the link_parcel_addresses / refresh_snapshot / classify_coa_trades precedent): guard is "none", so guard_columns is never consulted to build an IS DISTINCT FROM clause, and scope_classified_at (source run_at) is never a change guard on this target.

write_discipline.scope: description IS NOT NULL AND description <> '' AND (scope_classified_at IS NULL OR scope_classified_at < last_seen_at) — the pending set the stream selects (W4A-R4 (a), the §6.3 watermark pin on the coa root's last_seen_at)

idempotent_rerun_why.text: A second run straight after the first streams nothing: every row the first run classified now has scope_classified_at = that run's clock, which is not below last_seen_at until the coa root touches the row again.

invalidates.when: the coa root (scripts/load-coa.js) moves coa_applications.last_seen_at past a CoA's scope_classified_at — it touches last_seen_at for every fed key (load-coa.js:565-582; R-DZ keeps that touch), so every CoA in each feed becomes pending again; link_coa's tier UPDATEs also set last_seen_at on a CoA they link (scripts/link-coa.js:242, :332), which re-arms it the same way (#44 (e) derives link_coa as an upstream). W4A-R4 (a): the §6.3 watermark pin (staleness.pins row on coa). This is the step's OWN row, the one execution.phases[0].invalidator_ref indexes (claim #54); #44 (i) resolves it by Spec 124 R-ER arm (ii) (own column, own pin on the coa root's same-table stamp). The coa root's producer-side row (the link_massing form, resolved by this step's pin, R-DO arm (i)) is owed at the coa root's ②.

why.text: One statement shape: the explicit-VALUES UPDATE per flush (batch size classify_coa_scope_batch_size), each its own short transaction via ctx.flushBatch. No retraction (a CoA whose description becomes empty keeps its last classification — the legacy behaviour, CCS-D3 kept at parity per wave-4 plan recommendation 12).

W4A-R4 (a), operator y 2026-10-18: the §6.3 watermark pin. The pending predicate scope_classified_at IS NULL OR scope_classified_at < last_seen_at compares this step's watermark with the coa root's touch stamp (buildSourceSql) — the enrich_parcels pins[0] precedent on link_massing. It also resolves this step's own by:"pin" invalidates row (Spec 124 R-ER arm (ii)).

coa_applications has RLS enabled with ZERO policies (assessment §1.4, read-only DB, Spec 114 Class B). Under a non-bypass role the UPDATE affects 0 rows with no error, the counters read 0 and the verdict reads PASS. The bypass is the precondition, checked before the first read (Spec 124 R-CT; trap 2).

on_check_error_why.text: Every check reads a counter the classify pass already measured in the same run; a check that throws is a compute defect and must redden the run.

The threshold reads the step-owned copy classify_coa_scope_unmapped_max_pct (migration 271, W4A-R1 copy form); the legacy name stays until ③ because the legacy shell reads it.

limitations.what: A CoA whose description later becomes empty leaves the pending set with its last classification (no retraction) — the legacy behaviour, kept at parity (wave-4 plan recommendation 12: legacy defects are declared, not fixed inside the conversion).

Because the coa root touches last_seen_at for every fed key, each feed re-classifies every CoA it carries even when its description did not change (33,280 pending measured 2026-10-18 after the H6 --full runs). The classifier is deterministic, so the values do not move; scope_classified_at does, which re-triggers classify_coa_trades' cursor for the same CoAs (parity, wave-4 plan §B.2.4 note 1).

recovery.reset: UPDATE coa_applications SET scope_classified_at = NULL WHERE description IS NOT NULL AND description <> '' — the next run re-classifies every CoA with a description (idempotent: the classifier is deterministic).

interrupted_why.text: No shared transaction (execution.txn_scope none): each ctx.flushBatch is its own short transaction, so a run killed mid-stream leaves earlier batches committed and every unflushed CoA still pending under the cursor; the next run picks them up with no special recovery branch.

why.text: The legacy records_total = processed (classify-coa-scope.js:246): the CoAs streamed this run. matched.compute.<name> is the ENRICHER counter root.
The step INSERTs nothing (the sole write is an UPDATE); a declared finite 0, the fleet-standard ENRICHER form (compute_parcel_cost_estimates counters.records_new).

The legacy records_updated = the SUM of UPDATE rowCounts (WF3 BUG-1, pinned L8). ctx.flushBatch is never seam-owned, so written.e1.updated is filled from the pass's own returned {updated, scanned} (the compute_parcel_cost_estimates form).
The classify phase ran and unmapped_scope_pct met its bound.
The phase ran and the unmapped share is above classify_coa_scope_unmapped_max_pct (the Day-1 WARN). Row-derived.
Advisory lock 4202 held elsewhere: nothing streams, writes or emits beyond the row-derived SKIP summary (pinned L4).
The rls_bypass_or_policy precondition on coa_applications is not met (R-CT), checked before the first read.
A declared logic variable resolved absent or outside its [min, max] under on_invalid fail — above the lock (hoisted_above_gate), the legacy 'logicVars validation failed' refusal (pinned L3).
A batch UPDATE threw (on_row_error fail_fast, on_batch_error fail_step): that batch rolls back, earlier batches stay committed, the rows stay pending for the next run.
